title: 10. Exercises: Testing Concurrent Code
objectives: Solve the Testing Concurrent Code exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Async Test Suite

Create comprehensive test suite for async HTTP client.

### Exercise 2: Thread Safety Tester

Create automated thread safety tester for classes.

### Exercise 3: Deadlock Test

Create test that reliably detects deadlock potential.

### Exercise 4: Timeout Tester

Create utility for testing timeouts reliably.

### Exercise 5: Race Condition Finder

Create tool to find race conditions via testing.

### Exercise 6: Mock Event Loop

Create fully mockable event loop for testing.

### Exercise 7: Concurrent Fuzzer

Create fuzzer for concurrent code.

### Exercise 8: State Machine Tests

Create state machine tests for concurrent data structures.

### Exercise 9: Coverage for Async

Create tool to measure coverage of async code paths.

### Exercise 10: CI Pipeline

Create CI pipeline for concurrent code testing.
